Maya (CS): Heads-up — HarborGrid just crossed an embedding throughput inflection. Seen a 3.8x increase in embeddings/s over last 48h. Looks like two new teams started sending traffic (Ops + Merchant Support).
Maya (CS): They opened a support ticket asking about latency spikes around peak checkout windows.
Lina (CSM): Thanks Maya. Do we know which route/model they're hitting? any model variants?
Maya (CS): Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/example/harborgrid/metrics — top route is `/embed/customer-vector` against `open-3-xl` quantized. Peak qps ~ 220, p95 latency from logs ~ 420ms.
Ravi (SRE): 420ms p95 on quantized open-3-xl for embed sounds like cold-kv + small batch hitting. Do we have KV-cache enabled for that route?
Maya (CS): Not on by default — they’ve been using self-service defaults. Jordan (AE) ran a quick config with them yesterday.
Jordan (AE): Confirm — they asked for fast setup, we gave sample config. No explicit caching or batching changes.
Sasha (PM): HarborGrid is in a renewal conversation next quarter. This expansion looks promising but we need to mitigate the latency/regressions or it could become a blocker.
Lina (CSM): Action items: 1) Schedule an enablement session for Ops + Merchant Support, 2) propose a short Dedicated trial or burst plan, 3) fix immediate perf knobs.
Ravi (SRE): Immediate perf suggestions: enable KV prefix caching, set `batch_max_tokens: 4096` and `batch_target_ms: 30`, and bump concurrency to 6 for that route. Also suggest switching to `embed-3-small-quant` variant for cost.
Maya (CS): Will propose that to the customer in a sync tomorrow. Can Solutions Eng do a quick runbook / one-pager we can send?
Ravi (SRE): I'll drop a runbook snippet here by EOD. Quick snippet:
```
- enable_kv_cache: true
- batch_config:
    max_tokens: 4096
    target_ms: 30
- concurrency: 6
- fallback_model: embed-3-small-quant
```
Maya (CS): Perfect. Lina — can you coordinate the enablement slot? Preferably before their next peak window (Fridays 14:00 PT).
Lina (CSM): On it. I'll propose two slots: Thu 10:00 PT or Fri 13:00 PT.
Jordan (AE): Also flag for sales — if they adopt Dedicated for Ops team we should surface an expansion package. Possible uplift 20-30% ARR.
Sasha (PM): Noted. Let's also capture feedback about the self-serve defaults being too conservative for multi-team onboards — might need a prescriptive onboarding path for multi-team accounts.
Maya (CS): Agreed. I'll capture their feedback during the enablement and update the onboarding template.
infra-bot: Alert recorded: customer_embed_qps_change (HarborGrid) — +280% over 24h. Ticket #CS-8241 created.
Maya (CS): Closing loop — sending a short pre-read to HarborGrid with the perf knobs + runbook and propose Dedicated trial. Will update thread after the enablement.
Ravi (SRE): If the trial goes well we should propose canary rollout across teams and a staged capacity plan.
Lina (CSM): Thanks all — moving to schedule.
Maya (CS): Thanks — tagging @Ravi for runbook and @Jordan to prep the commercial uplift options. :thumbsup:
